messages:
Laura (Sales): Heads-up — customer wants a 7-day private POC on-prem. Asking for a short checklist: API key for hosted fallback, Dedicated pool sizing, and exact node preflight for private installer. They also flagged pricing and an outstanding security questionnaire.
Jason (SRE): Got it. Do they want control-plane in their VPC or routed to our private control plane? That changes firewall rules and IP allowlist.
Laura (Sales): They want the control-plane in their VPC (private control plane). Also asked if we can restrict control-plane egress.
Sam (Infra): For private control-plane mode: need VPC peering or Transit GW, 2 outbound ports (443 + 443/tls) to our collector endpoints, and static egress IPs on their side for allowlist.
Sam (Infra): Preflight for nodes: kernel >= 5.15, nvidia-driver >= 525 (535 preferred), CUDA 11.8+ (we recommend CUDA 12.x for newer models). kubelet cgroup driver=systemd.
Jason (SRE): Quick verification commands I give to customers: `uname -r`, `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader`, `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `cat /etc/default/grub` (to confirm `nvidia` drivers not blacklisted).
Laura (Sales): Perfect — can you paste a short template I can put in the pre-POC email? Also pricing note: they requested hourly Dedicated pool pricing + overage rules.
Jason (SRE): Template snippet: "Please run these checks and paste outputs: `uname -r`, `nvidia-smi`, `kubectl get nodes -owide`, `systemctl status nvidia-persistenced`. Ensure kubelet cgroup driver=systemd and `nvidia-container-toolkit` installed"
Amy (Security): Security Qs: They want KMS integration for disk encryption, audit log retention >=90d, SOC2 cert copy, and confirmation that control-plane traffic uses mTLS. Also need proof of vulnerability scanning on our images.
Laura (Sales): They want an answer on SOC2 and image scanning today. Amy, can we share the standard SOC2 pack and the vuln-scan summary?
Amy (Security): I can share SOC2 summary and a sanitized vuln-scan export. For KMS: customer-managed keys are supported in private mode (we'll need CMK ARN and a policy).
deploy-bot: preflight-check v1.9 ran at 2026-02-18T14:02Z — basic connectivity OK, missing: `nvidia-container-toolkit` (node-03), kubelet cgroup=systemd mismatch on node-02. See /preflight/report/1769001234.
Sam (Infra): Action items: 1) Customer runs Jason's commands and shares outputs. 2) Install `nvidia-container-toolkit` on node-03, upgrade driver on node-02 or set cgroup to systemd. 3) Sales to confirm Dedicated hourly estimate vs fixed 7-day commit — I'll share cost sketch.
Laura (Sales): I'll package this into the email and ping customer for outputs. Thanks all — I’ll follow up with the preflight outputs and the pricing question update before EOD. :thumbsup:
